title: Month 4 Day 25
notes: This teaching dives deeply into Deuteronomy 13, outlining the serious test for a prophet or dreamer who performs signs and wonders yet leads people after other gods. It draws powerful parallels to the false accusations against Stephen and Yeshua, the warnings of the man of lawlessness in 2 Thessalonians 2, and the deceptive miracles of the Beast in Revelation 13. The study covers the handling of false prophets and entire idolatrous cities under Torah law, historical examples like Elijah confronting Ahab and Jezebel on Carmel, and the ultimate call to absolute loyalty to Yahweh above all relationships (Matthew 10).
